{"Implementation approach":"Preserve protocol files exactly: pom.xml, src/main/java/Main.java (default package), and a single test file src/test/java/MainTest.java. Use Maven with Java 11, JUnit 5 via maven-surefire-plugin. Keep runtime entry thin and non-interactive. Separate pure domain logic (positions, snake body, movement rules, collisions, scoring) from environment/runtime (only Main and a RandomSource adapter using java.util.Random). Inject a RandomSource to control food placement deterministically in tests. Provide a canonical API via SnakeGame with immutable GameSnapshot for read-only state and a MoveOutcome enum for tick results. Tests are headless and deterministic, focus on runtime wiring through Main and representative rules: movement with reversal rejection, food consumption/growth, and collision. Implement rules: grid origin top-left; bounds [0..w-1],[0..h-1]; disallow immediate reversal; tick advances one cell; on food consumption, grow and +1 score; walls/self collisions end game; food placement chooses uniformly among free cells using RandomSource; when no free cells remain, set game over; validate inputs. placeFoodAt validates emptiness and bounds and replaces food deterministically (useful for tests). Tests must import these classes by their simple names since no package statements are used.

Position (src/main/java/Position.java)
- public final class Position
- Constructors/Factories:
  - public Position(int x, int y): creates an immutable coordinate. May be used with any non-negative values expected by callers; validation of grid bounds is performed by SnakeGame.
  - public static Position of(int x, int y): convenience factory; same semantics as constructor.
- Methods:
  - public int getX()
  - public int getY()
  - public Position plus(int dx, int dy): returns a new Position with x+dx, y+dy.
  - public boolean equals(Object o), public int hashCode(), public String toString(): standard value semantics.
- Errors: plus throws no exceptions; constructor/factory may validate inputs are integers; grid bound checks are deferred to callers.

Direction (src/main/java/Direction.java)
- public enum Direction { UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT }
- Methods:
  - public int dx(): returns -1, 0, or 1 X-step for this direction.
  - public int dy(): returns -1, 0, or 1 Y-step for this direction.
  - public boolean isOpposite(Direction other): returns true if moving to other would be an immediate reversal.
- Errors: dx, dy, isOpposite never throw for non-null receivers; isOpposite(null) returns false or throws IllegalArgumentException if implemented to validate; preferred: returns false if other is null.

RandomSource (src/main/java/RandomSource.java)
- public interface RandomSource
- Methods:
  - int nextInt(int bound): returns a uniformly distributed int in [0, bound). Contract: bound must be > 0; implementors may throw IllegalArgumentException for invalid bound.

JavaUtilRandomSource (src/main/java/JavaUtilRandomSource.java)
- public final class JavaUtilRandomSource implements RandomSource
- Constructors:
  - public JavaUtilRandomSource(long seed): deterministic for a given seed.
- Methods:
  - public int nextInt(int bound): delegates to java.util.Random, validating bound > 0; throws IllegalArgumentException if bound <= 0.

MoveOutcome (src/main/java/MoveOutcome.java)
- public enum MoveOutcome { MOVED, ATE_FOOD, GAME_OVER }
- Semantics: result classification for a single tick.

Snake (src/main/java/Snake.java)
- public final class Snake
- Constructors:
  - public Snake(Position start): creates a snake with a single-segment body at start.
- Methods:
  - public Position head(): returns current head position.
  - public Position tail(): returns current tail position.
  - public int length(): number of segments.
  - public boolean occupies(Position p): true if any segment equals p.
  - public void moveTo(Position nextHead): adds nextHead at head and removes the last tail segment.
  - public void growTo(Position nextHead): adds nextHead at head and retains tail (length+1).
  - public java.util.List<Position> bodyAsList(): returns a defensive immutable/copy list of body positions in head-to-tail order.
- Errors: Public methods validate non-null inputs and throw NullPointerException or IllegalArgumentException as appropriate.

GameSnapshot (src/main/java/GameSnapshot.java)
- public final class GameSnapshot
- Constructors:
  - public GameSnapshot(int width, int height, java.util.List<Position> body, Position food, int score, boolean gameOver, Direction direction)
- Methods:
  - public int getWidth()
  - public int getHeight()
  - public java.util.List<Position> getSnakeBody(): returns an unmodifiable copy/view.
  - public Position getFood()
  - public int getScore()
  - public boolean isGameOver()
  - public Direction getDirection()
  - public String toString(): concise summary for debugging/logging.
- Semantics: immutable snapshot suitable for observers/tests; must not reflect future state changes.

SnakeGame (src/main/java/SnakeGame.java)
- public final class SnakeGame
- Constructors:
  - public SnakeGame(int width, int height, RandomSource rng): initializes a new game with the snake at a valid starting cell, score=0, gameOver=false, initial direction (implementation-defined but consistent), and a randomly placed food on a free cell using rng.
- Methods:
  - public void reset(): resets to a fresh game state using the same width, height, and rng; places food randomly.
  - public boolean setDirection(Direction dir): sets intended movement direction if dir is non-null and not an immediate reversal of current direction; returns true if accepted, false if rejected.
  - public Direction getDirection(): current movement direction.
  - public MoveOutcome tick(): advances exactly one cell by current direction. If next head is food, grows snake, increments score by 1, places new food randomly among free cells; returns ATE_FOOD. If next head is out-of-bounds or collides with the body, sets gameOver=true and returns GAME_OVER. Otherwise moves normally and returns MOVED. If the board is full after eating (no free cells), sets gameOver=true.
  - public boolean isGameOver()
  - public int getScore()
  - public int getWidth()
  - public int getHeight()
  - public GameSnapshot snapshot(): returns an immutable snapshot of current state.
  - public void placeFoodAt(Position p): deterministically place food at p after validating bounds and that p is not occupied by the snake; useful for tests.
- Helper (non-public) methods:
  - private void placeFoodRandomly(): choose uniformly among free cells using rng.nextInt(bound) where bound equals count of free cells.
  - private boolean inBounds(Position p): 0 <= x < width and 0 <= y < height.
- Errors: Constructor and reset validate width>0 and height>0; throw IllegalArgumentException otherwise. placeFoodAt throws IllegalArgumentException for out-of-bounds or occupied cells. tick on gameOver leaves state unchanged and returns GAME_OVER.
- Grid: origin top-left; x increases to the right, y increases downward.

Main (src/main/java/Main.java)
- public final class Main
- Methods:
  - public static void main(String[] args): creates JavaUtilRandomSource with a fixed seed, constructs SnakeGame with a small grid, prints initial snapshot, performs a few deterministic ticks printing MoveOutcome and final snapshot, catches any Exception by printing a single line and exiting normally (no rethrow).

Import direction rules
- Core domain (Position, Direction, MoveOutcome, Snake, GameSnapshot, SnakeGame, RandomSource) must not import environment-dependent classes.
- Environment-dependent (Main, JavaUtilRandomSource) may depend on core domain.
- Tests import and exercise only the canonical API and may define in-test stubs for RandomSource.
","Shared Knowledge":"Project is a Maven Java 11 application. Core domain logic is separated from environment/runtime. Randomness is abstracted via RandomSource; JavaUtilRandomSource is the only environment adapter. SnakeGame orchestrates rules and exposes a stable API. GameSnapshot provides read-only state for tests/observers. Main is a minimal, non-interactive demo. Tests are headless, deterministic, and live in src/test/java/MainTest.java, validating runtime wiring and representative rules without GUI or I/O.","Execution Protocol":"Run tests with: mvn -q test. Runtime entry: src/main/java/Main.java. Single protocol-level test file: src/test/java/MainTest.java. No manual interaction. Tests must be deterministic, avoid timing/sleep, avoid file/network I/O, and use RandomSource injection or placeFoodAt for determinism.","Anything UNCLEAR":""}
